messages:
Jamie: Heads up — noticed a ~40% drop in onboarding healthscore for the EU cohort after last night's CRM import. Symptoms: onboarding stage stalled, NPS tag cleared on some accounts.
Priya: Ugh. Did we run the dedupe job that touches lifecycle_owner? I pushed a fix to the mapping last week.
Luca: I saw a bunch of nulls in `primary_owner_id` after the pipeline. Query I ran:
Luca: `SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE primary_owner_id IS NULL AND created_at > '2026-03-18';`
Luca: returned 1,132 rows.
Marta: That explains the sudden 'Unassigned' health buckets. Which playbook picks up unassigned accounts? @Priya
Priya: Playbook `onboard-auto-assign` should run on tag `needs-ownership` but the webhook consumer failed on malformed payload (missing `owner_email`).
Jamie: Can we patch the consumer fast? If assignments fail, renewal risk scoring skews too (no owner = no touchpoints).
Luca: I can hotfix the consumer—fix is small: add fallback mapping for `owner_email` -> `owner_id` lookup. Deploy in 10.
DeployBot: deploy requested by Luca for `cs-consumers/onboard-webhook`.
DeployBot: deployment started — canary -> 2 nodes.
OnboardBot: webhook replay queued (batch id 8912) — 1,132 messages.
Priya: Once replay finishes, we should re-run healthscore recalculation pipeline for affected accounts. Suggest running with `--force-recalc --reason=crm-import-fix`.
Jamie: Agreed. Also we need to avoid double-triggering playbook automations for accounts already marked `onboarded: true` — add an idempotency check.
Marta: Good call. Also let's add a telemetry breakpoint: capture before/after sample of 200 accounts to compare tokenized event counts and playbook runs.
Luca: I'll add the idempotency `if account['onboarded'] == true: skip` and a dry-run flag.
Priya: After recalc, can someone produce a quick query for renewal-risk delta? I want % accounts moving into >50% risk bucket.
Jamie: Use this for delta:
Jamie: `WITH before AS (SELECT id, healthscore FROM accounts_snapshot WHERE snapshot_ts = '2026-03-18'), after AS (SELECT id, healthscore FROM accounts WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-19') SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE after.healthscore >= 50 AND before.healthscore < 50) as moved_up FROM before JOIN after USING (id);`
Priya: Perfect. Also we should add an alert to Ops if dedupe runs touch >1000 rows with null owner.
Marta: Action items:
Marta: 1) Luca deploy consumer fix (in progress)
Marta: 2) OnboardBot replay (queued)
Marta: 3) Run recalc with force once replay done (Priya/Jamie)
Marta: 4) Query renewal-risk delta and share with CS leads (Priya)
Marta: 5) Add idempotency & telemetry checkpoint (Luca)
Priya: ETA on the replay? OnboardBot?
OnboardBot: replay batch 8912 completed — 1,132 messages processed; 1,120 assigned, 12 flagged for manual review.
Luca: Replay looks good. Starting recalc now. Running with `--sample=200 --force-recalc` first.
DeployBot: deployment succeeded for `cs-consumers/onboard-webhook` — 2 nodes green.
Jamie: Recalc finished: moved_up = 254 accounts into >50% renewal-risk compared to before.
Priya: Thanks — will share a short note to CS leads and adjust weekly runbooks to include this check. + follow-up: add a gating test in staging so malformed payloads are caught.
Marta: Nice work team. I'll convert these action items into a quick runbook and add to the `onboarding-ops` Confluence page.
Jamie: Heading out but ping me if anything else pops up. :sunglasses:
Priya: Closing the loop — I'll schedule the staging gating test for tomorrow AM.
Luca: Done with PR for idempotency, will link the diff in the runbook.
Marta: Thanks all :thumbsup:
